{{Quote|One of our spies on Naboo, Simo Oron, has been detained by Imperial forces.|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], to a Rebel spacer|<ref name="SWG:TSCL" />}}
'''Simo Oron''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Other arrangements are being made to rescue Simo Oron, a Rebel spy, as the Empire transfers him off of Naboo, but his personal effects are back at the small Imperial base where he was first being held.|C-3PO, to a Rebel spacer|<ref name="SWG:TSCL" />}}
[[File:SimoOronEffects.jpg|250px|thumb|Simo Oron's personal effects, including a crucial contact list]]
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Simo Oron resided on the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] where he worked under the orders of the spymaster [[Bertos Goodner]].<ref name="SWG:TSCL" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Simo Oron was captured by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and detained in a small [[Imperial Base (Naboo)|Imperial Base]] in the [[Lasay Swamp]] of Naboo. When news of his capture arrived to the [[Hidden Rebel Base|Rebel base]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], the Rebellion made arrangements to rescue Simo before he was transferred off world. However, his personal effects, including a sensitive contact list, were left behind. The Rebel droid [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] therefore tasked a group of Rebel operatives with obtaining his contact list in the Imperial base on Naboo before it ended up being discovered by the Empire. While the Rebel spacers succeeded in finding the contact list and handing it over to Bertos Goodner, Simo Oron was safely rescued.<ref name="SWG:TSCL" />

==Behind the scenes==
Simo Oron was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TSCL" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Mention of Simo Oron was added to the game with the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Rebel Theme Park|Rebel Theme Park]]," released with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 6 Notes for May 22 2007|Chapter 6]]" update, on [[May 22]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Notes – Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67250&month=052007|text=Publish Notes &ndash; Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild}}</ref>
